title: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
summary: The KV cache is a primary bottleneck for Transformer decoding: its memory footprint and cache-read traffic grow with sequence length. Grouped-query attention (GQA) reduces this cost by sharing key-value heads, but still stores both a key and a value at every step. We introduce Grouped Value Attention (GVA), which stores grouped values and reconstructs content keys with a learned linear map.
